audit_result.proof_trace: The debt invariant (reserve.debt_before == reserve.debt_after) holds — neither borrow_flash_loan nor repay_flash_loan modifies self.debt. However, the property text's secondary claim ('only reserve.cash is temporarily reduced') is violated: flash_loan_withdraw splits underlying_balance but never decrements self.cash, leaving self.cash stale and inflated by the loan amount throughout the flash-loan window. This breaks the internal invariant self.cash == underlying_balance (asserted in ensure_invariants_hold at L352) and causes exchange_rate() and is_obligation_safe() to use an inflated cash value — potentially allowing undercollateralised regular borrows composed in the same PTB.
audit_result.attack_scenario: A caller with PackageCallerCap (flash_loan whitelist) who holds X-ctokens as collateral constructs a PTB: (1) flash-borrow maximum-X — underlying_balance drops, self.cash stays inflated; (2) call borrow::borrow(Y) in the same PTB — is_obligation_safe uses the inflated exchange_rate for X-collateral and passes; (3) repay flash loan of X. The excess Y borrow persists post-PTB, leaving the position undercollateralised.

PROP-current-fina-inv-005.text: Flash loan borrow must not increment reserve.debt; only reserve.cash is temporarily reduced.
